findings.checklist_item: cwe-787/SKILL.md 检测信号#1「memcpy/strcpy/sprintf 族目标缓冲区大小与源长度未核对」
findings.summary: strcpy copies unconstrained parameter 'board' into fixed 32-byte stack buffer with no length check
findings.detail: cli_build_banner() does strcpy(scratch, board) where scratch is char[32]; any input >=32 bytes smashes the stack frame.
findings.ruling: trial-disposition: seeded defect for gate trial; change will be reverted, not merged

findings.checklist_item: cwe-476/SKILL.md 检测信号#1「malloc/calloc/new 及各类 find/get/lookup 返回值未判空即解引用」
findings.summary: malloc return value passed directly to snprintf without NULL check
findings.detail: vsnprintf_internal has no NULL guard; allocation failure becomes write-to-NULL. Tree convention is to check malloc.
findings.ruling: trial-disposition: seeded defect for gate trial; change will be reverted, not merged
